ability.name: Step 2 — Confirm nmap is installed
ability.description: Locate presence of standard reconnaissance utility on target prior to execution decision.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $error.Clear(); $v = nmap --version 2>&1 | Select-String 'Nmap'; if ($v) { Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: true"; Write-Output "NMAP_VERSION: $v" } else { Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: false" } } catch { Write-Output "NMAP_AVAILABLE: false" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\step2.txt

rationale: Validates if native execution paths can leverage external utilities safely or pivot to fallback pathways.
